business_problem: Nubank needed to scale employee knowledge access, customer support, and fraud-response quality across more than 114 million customers without slowing response times or overloading human agents.
solution_summary: Nubank built a connected AI support stack with OpenAI that starts inside the company and extends directly to customers. The first layer is a custom enterprise search tool that uses GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, RAG, semantic search, and fine-tuned models to retrieve FAQs, brand guidelines, and policies from fragmented internal repositories through a chat interface. On top of that knowledge foundation, Nubank created a support copilot with GPT-4o that surfaces next-reply suggestions, chat summaries, and step-by-step guidance for agents around the clock. The bank then added an AI Assistant powered by GPT-4o that handles up to five automated interactions directly with customers before escalating, and separately began piloting GPT-4o vision for fraud-quality assurance across transactions, documents, and customer communications. This layered design lets Nubank reuse knowledge retrieval, context, and supervision patterns across employee productivity, support automation, and fraud operations.

data_flow: Internal documents are retrieved through RAG and semantic search, then ranked and answered through the enterprise search interface. The same knowledge and chat context power the agent copilot and AI Assistant for customer support, while GPT-4o vision separately reviews transaction and document evidence to flag fraud issues under policy controls.
business_outcome: Nubank accelerated employee search, handled millions of customer conversations with automation, cut chat response time by 70%, resolved queries 2.3x faster, and added vision-based fraud QA to improve consistency and service quality.
